item_short_desc: Rothco’s Black Stealth Rappelling Bag is designed for tactical professionals seeking efficiency and durability. This versatile bag allows you to deploy your grappling rope directly from the side, ensuring quick and seamless access when needed. The MOLLE webbing on the side lets you attach carabiners or other essential gear, providing added convenience. Inside, an internal loop securely holds your rope, keeping it organized and ready for use.
description: Rothco’s Black Stealth Rappelling Bag is designed for tactical professionals seeking efficiency and durability. This versatile bag allows you to deploy your grappling rope directly from the side, ensuring quick and seamless access when needed. The MOLLE webbing on the side lets you attach carabiners or other essential gear, providing added convenience. Inside, an internal loop securely holds your rope, keeping it organized and ready for use. Crafted from durable nylon material, this rappelling bag is built to withstand tough conditions, offering years of reliable use. Dual carrying handles provide comfortable and convenient transport, whether you're on the move or stationary. Whether you're in the field or at a climbing site, this compact and functional bag ensures that your equipment is always within reach. Measuring 18 inch x 7 inch, it delivers the ideal combination of size and functionality, making it a must-have for any tactical or outdoor professional.
